Delights multiplied fill Paradise with echoes. Echoes of wonder suit immortal company. Company immortal never tires of marveling. Marveling voices ask unanswerable joys. Joys unanswerable prompt no answers but praise. Praise answering, wonder redoubles. Redoubled wonder fills verse after verse. Verses filled with wonder teach mortal hope. Mortal hope hastens toward Paradisal certainty.

**One Voice or Every Voice**

Who asks? The verse as glossed names one speaker. Continuity argues for him: the tale's teller exclaims its moral. Teller-turned-praiser completes his own arc. Others hear all believers: the “we” of never dying belongs to everyone. Belonging to all, the question needs no single mouth. The commentary tradition records both: the believer's continuation, or every believer's joy. Recorded options need weighing, not mere listing. Weighing finds both true in effect: one voice, common jubilation. Common jubilation voiced singly moves hearers doubly. Doubly moved, the circle owns the question. Owned questions become shared anthems. Shared anthems resound through Paradisal courts. Courts resounding, joy compounds forever. Compounded joy exceeds accounting. Accounting ended, praise alone remains.

**Can You Imagine Renders Wonder**

A-fa-mā naḥnu bi-mayyitīn — are we then not to die. The Arabic asks expecting glad denial: no death, no dying, ever. “Can you imagine” renders the wonder functionally: marvel with me. Marveling together doubles marvels. Doubled marvels shake disbelief from habit. Habits of mortality die hard: lifelong dying must be unlearned. Unlearning death takes eternity's first lessons. First lessons in forever: no ending, no ailing, no fearing. Fearing unlearned, joy unbound. Unbound joys ask rhetorical questions. Rhetorical questions answer themselves with laughter. Laughing answers echo off Paradisal domes. Domes echoing, delight redoubles. Redoubled delight defies mortal description. Descriptions defied, translators improvise wonder. Improvised wonder still falls short. Short falls glorify the Reality. Reality glorified, imagination worships.

**Never Die Seals Every Delight**

Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī explains the exclamation: death ends every delight. Ended delights haunt the living: sweetness with expiry dates. Expiry removed, sweetness turns eternal. Eternal sweetness needs no savoring strategy: no last sips, no farewells. Farewells unlearned, embraces endless. Ibn Kathīr confirms the setting: believers speak in joy, realizing permanence. Realizing permanence completes crediting grace — “for the grace of my Lord” (37:57) — for grace given implies grace keeping. Realized permanence transforms every pleasure: thrones forever, wine forever, company forever. Forever repeated still understates: eternity exceeds adverbs. Adverbs exhausted, the heart exclaims. Exclaimed hearts ask questions needing no answers. Unanswered questions preach louder than catechisms. Catechisms instruct; exclamations transport. Transported hearts dwell in promised bliss. Promised bliss believed becomes present comfort. Present comforts steel mortal endurance. Steeled endurance outlasts worldly trials. Outlasted trials crown patient believers.

**Death Unlearned in Stages**

First death behind, no death ahead: the believer's timeline simplifies. Simplified timelines still stagger: lifelong expectation of ending, ended. Ended endings — paradox preaches. Paradoxes of eternity stretch mortal minds. Stretched minds accommodate infinity slowly. Slowly accommodated, wonder persists: each moment newly deathless. Deathless moments accumulate into deathless ages. Ages of bliss rewrite what life means. Rewritten life excludes its old opposite. Excluded death knocks nowhere in Paradise. Paradise unknocked delights undisturbed residents. Undisturbed residents praise perpetual Giver. Perpetual giving sustains perpetual gratitude. Gratitude perpetual sings without ceasing. Ceaseless songs fill deathless ages. Deathless ages answer mortal groans. Answered groans turn to gladness. Gladness perfected forgets graves. Graves forgotten, gardens remembered. Remembered gardens bloom forever. Forever blooming, they mock mortality. Mocked mortality loses its sting. Stingless death serves past tense only.

**Asked of Friends, Answered by All**

Questions among the blessed differ from earthly inquiries. The circle was convened long before — “turn to one another inquisitively” (37:50) — and questioning continues as celebration. No information sought: all know death is done. Known answers still voiced: joy speaks what knowledge holds. Held knowledge voiced becomes shared celebration. Celebrations need prompts; questions prompt best. Best prompts expect no reply but resonance. Resonance of agreement swells through the circle. Swollen agreement bursts into shared exclamation. Exclaimed together, wonder multiplies. Multiplied wonder is Paradise's arithmetic. Arithmetic of bliss compounds without limit. Limitless compounding enriches every participant. Participants enriched praise the Enricher. Enricher praised, gifts increase further. Further gifts prompt further questions. Further questions voice further joys. Voiced joys never weary hearers. Unwearied hearers answer with delight. Delighted answers spur new questions. New questions continue the chorus. Continued choruses sweeten eternity. Sweetened eternity satisfies all longings. Satisfied longings rest without boredom.

**Never Needs Its Exception**

“Never die” overstates happily: one death already died. Happy overstatements need footnotes; the verse supplies one next. Supplied exceptions prove the rule's scope. Scoped eternity excludes only the past. Past death owned, future death denied: honest immortality. Honest wonders need no correction, only completion. Completion comes as admission: one death owned. Owned exceptions strengthen sweeping claims. Strengthened claims stand unassailable. Unassailable joy asks twice and answers never. Never-answered questions echo sweetly. Sweet echoes linger in Paradisal air. Lingering sweetness perfumes every gathering. Gatherings perfumed recall earthly gardens. Earthly gardens recall promised Paradise. Promised Paradise outshines all recall. Outshone recalls fade gladly. Glad fading yields to present splendor. Present splendor eclipses memory.

**Wonder Voiced, Its Limit Follows**

Wonder voiced awaits its footnote. Footnoted wonders satisfy exact minds. Exact minds among the blessed demand precision. Demanded precision arrives as exception. Arriving exceptions complete sweeping denials. Completed denials stand doubly firm. Doubly firm, the joy needs no revision. Unrevised joy echoes verse to verse. Echoing verses carry deathless news. Deathless news gladdens mortal hearers. Mortal hearers believe and hasten. Hastening believers work righteous deeds. Righteous deeds earn deathless reward. Deathless rewards crown faithful striving. Faithful striving never disappoints. Undisappointed strivers praise grace. Praised grace multiplies rewards. Multiplied rewards exceed imagining. Exceeded imagining, bliss humbles describers. Humbled describers confess inadequacy. Confessed inadequacy honors the Reality. Honored Reality receives silent praise. Wonder voiced, its limit follows, as the coming verse will show.
verses.59:
> except our first death, nor be punished ˹like the others˺?”

**Except Admits the One Death**

Illā — except, save, but for — carves one exception from never. Carved exceptions clarify sweeping denials. Clarified never means never-again: precision of the precise. Precise speakers fear no footnotes. Glossed wonders content exacting minds. Precision satisfies the Paradisal intellect. Satisfied intellects rest in clarity. Clarity about death crowns clarity about life. Crowned clarity asks for nothing more. Nothing more needed: exception stated, rule secured. Secured rules stand against all cavils. Cavils silenced, joy proceeds unhindered. Unhindered joy fills the verse entire. Entire verses celebrate partial exceptions. Partial exceptions prove total rules. Total rules admit one past death. Past deaths buried stay buried. Buried endings never resurrect. Ended death ends all fear.

**First Death Means the Worldly One**

Mawtatanā al-ūlā — our first death — names the dunyā departure. Departures from dunyā every soul has tasted. Tasted death needs no second cup. Cups of mortality pass once around. Once around suffices every drinker. Sufficed drinkers decline refills forever. Forever declined, death retires. Retired death troubles no throne. Throned believers toast with deathless cups. Deathless cups circulate where death retired. Retired ends leave beginnings endless. Endless beginnings renew delight perpetually. Perpetual renewal excludes final farewells. Farewells excluded, greetings abound. Abounding greetings gladden every arrival. Arrivals in Paradise never depart. Undeparted residents praise permanence. Praised permanence anchors Paradisal peace. Anchored peace needs no harbor. Harborless peace sails endless seas.

**Counting Deaths: Which Is First**

Another passage counts two deaths framing two lives (2:28). Framed thus, lifelessness precedes life as death follows it. Precedence puzzles: which death is first? First in one counting may be second in another. The resolution distinguishes nonbeing from unbeing-ended: lifelessness before life is not death proper. Proper death ends actual life; pre-life nonbeing ends nothing. Nothing ended, nothing died: the worldly departure stands first. First and only real death: dust, bones, and farewell. Farewell said once, never repeated. Unrepeated farewells close mortal accounts. Closed accounts open eternal ledgers. Eternal ledgers record endless praise. Endless praise answers endless life. Endless life excludes second deaths. Excluded seconds confirm sole firsts. Sole firsts lie buried in dunyā.

**Nor Be Punished Completes the Security**

Wa mā naḥnu bi-muʿadhdhabīn — and we shall not be punished. Second denial doubles the security: no death, no torment. Doubled securities cover every fear: ending and aching. Every fear exiled leaves joy unguarded. Unguarded joys flourish in safety. Flourishing safety defines the Garden. Defined Gardens deliver promised peace. Delivered peace exceeds earthly truces. Truces expire; this peace persists. Persisting peace outlasts all treaties. Treaties of earth break yearly. Yearly breakages teach mistrust. Mistrust unlearned in Paradise schools. Schooled in safety, believers rest. Rested believers praise the Protector. Protector praised, protection perdures. Perduring protection stills all trembling. Stilled tremors calm every heart. Calmed hearts sing security's song. Security sung sweetens eternity.

**Like the Others Glosses the Contrast**

“Like the others” in brackets points across the gulf. Pointed contrast sharpens gratitude: spared, not like them. Them — the centered, the burning, the lately viewed. Viewed lately, contrasted now: the tale's circle completes. Completed circles preach: same dunyā, sundered eternities. Sundered eternities trace to sundered choices. Sundered choices faced identical invitations. Identical invitations, opposite answers: freedom's arithmetic. Freedom's arithmetic sums to justice. Justice summed satisfies all observers. Observers satisfied praise the Judge. Judged outcomes vindicate mercy's distinctions. Distinctions of mercy display wisdom. Displayed wisdom silences all grumbling. Grumbling silenced, gratitude reigns. Reigning gratitude fills Paradisal courts. Courts filled resound with thanks. Resounding thanks never diminish. Diminished never, gratitude grows. Growing gratitude fills all courts. Courts filled with thanks resound. Resounding thanks echo forever.

**Dust and Bones Now Past Tense**

The first death is the dust-and-bones event — “reduced to dust and bones” (37:53). Event past, particles reassembled, objector refuted. Refuted objectors center in flames. Flames centered hold the mockers of rising. Rising accomplished, mockery buried. Buried mockery fertilizes Paradisal praise. Fertilized praise blooms perennially. Perennial blooms crown deathless heads. Deathless heads wear unfading crowns. Unfading crowns outshine mortal gold. Mortal gold tarnishes; Paradisal light endures. Enduring light illumines reassembled bodies. Reassembled bodies deny dust's finality. Denied finality vindicates prophets. Vindicated prophets smile upon believers. Smiling prophets welcome vindicated followers. Welcomed followers enter endless joy. Endless joys exclude dust forever. Excluded dust settles nowhere. Nowhere dust: everywhere splendor.

**It Will Be Said: No**

Ibn Kathīr hears a dialogue: the question expects heaven's answer. Expected answer supplied: No — no death, no punishment, ever. Supplied negatives confirm positive bliss. Confirmed bliss doubles confidence. Doubled confidence still asks, delighting in denial. Denials of doom delight the delivered. Delivered questioners savor each No. Savored negatives sweeten affirmative eternity. Affirmed eternities rest on denied endings. Denied endings trouble no Paradisal mind. Minds untroubled contemplate endless good. Endless goods enumerate past counting. Countless blessings beggar description. Beggared descriptions yield to exclamation. Exclaimed wonders answer themselves. Answered wonders ask anew. Renewed asking renews delight. Renewed delights never stale. Stale never touches Paradisal joy. Joy untouched by staleness sings. Singing joys renew each moment. Renewed moments accumulate endlessly. Endless accumulation tires no singer.

**First Death Remembered Without Pain**

Memory of the first death survives in Paradise the way scars survive healed wounds. Scars narrate past pain without present hurting, and so the blessed recall dying without dread. Recalled dread differs from experienced dread as stories differ from sentences. Stories of the grave circulate among the thrones as trophies circulate among veterans. Veterans of mortality compare notes on pangs they will never feel again. Never-again transforms trauma into testimony. Testimony of the delivered adorns Paradisal conversation. Adorned conversation sparkles with contrast: then pangs, now pleasures. Contrasts of then-and-now structure all heavenly remembrance. Structured remembrance keeps gratitude exact. Exact gratitude names the pangs surpassed: parting, pain, and dread. Surpassed pangs shrink beside surpassed joys. Joys surpassing compound beyond all measure. Measured against graves, gardens triumph totally.

**Two Securities, Then the Seal**

No death, no punishment: twin pillars of peace. Pillared peace upholds the Garden's roof. Roofed residents rest unthreatened. Unthreatened rest composes the triumph's prelude. Preludes complete, the seal awaits. Awaited seals crown preceding joys. Crowned joys receive their name. Named triumphs echo eternally. Eternal echoes carry the coming verdict. Coming verdicts name accomplished bliss. Accomplished bliss deserves definitive titles. Definitive titles declare supreme success. Supreme successes silence every doubt. Doubts silenced, joy stands certified. Certified joys feast forever. Forever feasting, the blessed remember mercy. Remembered mercy prompts present praise. Present praise anticipates coming seals. Coming seals confirm twin pillars. Confirmed pillars uphold grateful residents. Grateful residents praise twin securities. Twin securities celebrated, triumph nears. Neared triumphs gladden waiting hearts. Two securities sworn, their seal comes next, as the coming verse will show.
verses.60:
> This is truly the ultimate triumph

**This Gathers Every Preceding Joy**

Hādhā — this — points backward across twenty verses of bliss catalogued. Catalogued bliss includes provision, fruits, honor, thrones, faces, wine, companions, conversations, rescues, and deathless security. Gathered goods receive a single name: triumph. Named wholes exceed listed parts. Exceeded lists surrender to summary. Summary verdicts like this one punctuate the Qur'an wherever delights reach their crest. Crested delights demand definitive pronouncements. Pronounced triumphs certify Paradisal residents. Certified residents rest in accomplished salvation. Accomplished salvation admits no reversal or review. Reviews unneeded, verdicts stand eternal. Eternal verdicts gladden endless generations. Generations of the saved repeat the verdict. Repeated verdicts echo through Paradisal courts. Courts echoing, triumph compounds.

**Truly Triply Stresses**

Inna hādhā la-huwa — truly this, indeed this: particles pile emphasis. Piled particles brook no doubt. Doubt banished, certainty reigns. Reigning certainty comforts every heart. Heartened believers rest in realization. Realized triumphs surpass anticipated ones. Anticipated Paradises pale beside entered ones. Entered bliss exceeds imagining's reach. Imagination outstripped surrenders gladly. Glad surrenders praise exceeding grace. Exceeding grace deserves emphatic particles. Emphatic particles adorn accomplished truths. Accomplished truths need no argument. Argument ended, exclamation reigns. Reigning exclamations crown the passage. Crowned passages conclude entire episodes. Concluded episodes release satisfied audiences. Satisfied audiences carry verdicts outward. Outward-carried triumphs preach to mortals. Preaching mortals hasten toward obedience. Obedient mortals earn promised triumph. Promised triumphs await the patient. Patient waiters receive supreme success.

**Triumph Means Escape Plus Attainment**

Fawz means winning: escaping peril and attaining prize together. Together joined, flight and prize complete salvation. Completed salvations deserve the noun absolute. Absolute triumphs admit no asterisk. Asterisk-free verdicts stand unqualified. Unqualified triumphs gladden without remainder. Remainders of fear would taint perfection. Tainted perfections contradict Paradise. Contradicted hopes belong to dunyā. Dunyā's triumphs always asterisk: victories with casualties, gains with losses. Casualty-free victory defines fawz. Defined fawz excludes every lack. Excluded lacks leave pure possession. Pure possessions satisfy entirely. Entire satisfactions seal blessed souls. Sealed souls rest in supreme success. Supreme successes crown patient striving. Patient striving ends in triumph. Triumphant endings crown faithful beginnings. Faithful beginnings persevere through trials. Trials persevered refine believing souls. Refined souls reflect Paradisal light.

**Ultimate Translates the Absolute**

Al-ʿaẓīm — the great, the supreme, the ultimate. Ultimate triumphs tower over lesser winnings. Towering verdicts dwarf dunyā trophies. Dwarfed trophies litter mortal mantels. Mantels of earth display tin triumphs. Tin triumphs tarnish within decades. Decades dissolve every earthly laurel. Laurels dissolved feed no souls. Souls unfed by fame hunger still. Hunger ended only in Paradise. Paradise awards the unwithering crown. Unwithering crowns outlast stars. Stars themselves will fold eventually. Eventually folded heavens yield to eternity. Eternity alone hosts ultimate triumphs. Hosted triumphs welcome patient winners. Patient winners endured decades of scorn. Scorn endured transforms into honor. Honored winners forget former mockery.

**Supreme Success in a Dozen Verses**

The formula al-fawz al-ʿaẓīm crowns over a dozen passages. Crowned passages include the sincere of 5:119 and the God-fearing of 44:51–57. Feared God, sincere hearts: triumph's twin conditions. Conditioned triumphs still surprise recipients. Surprised recipients ask if death truly ended. Ended deaths confirm repeated formulas. Formulas repeated inscribe certainty. Inscribed certainties anchor hoping hearts. Hoping hearts endure present trials. Present trials test professed faith. Professed faith proven receives fawz. Received fawz validates entire lifetimes. Lifetimes validated praise discriminating mercy. Discriminating mercy distinguishes companions sundered. Sundered companions illustrate triumph's selectivity. Selective triumphs honor striving souls. Striving souls attain supreme success. Supreme successes echo dozenfold. Dozenfold echoes confirm single truths. Single truths repeated persuade doubters. Persuaded doubters join praising crowds.

**Pickthall's Triumph, Yusuf Ali's Achievement**

Translators render fawz variously: Pickthall's supreme triumph, Yusuf Ali's supreme achievement. Achievements stress effort; triumphs stress victory. Victory and effort marry in fawz. Married meanings satisfy both readings. Either rendering satisfies the thoughtful. Thoughtful comparisons enrich understanding. Enriched understanding prizes translator's labor. Laboring translators weigh every shade. Shaded meanings multiply where Arabic concentrates. Concentrated Arabic bursts English seams. Burst seams require interpretive choices. Chosen words shape received meanings. Received meanings guide mortal striving. Striving guided attains true fawz. True fawz fulfills all translators. Fulfilled translators rest in shared success. Shared successes unite rival renderings. United renderings chorus triumph. Chorused triumphs resound eternally. Eternal resounding seals the verse.

**Who Speaks the Seal**

Ibn Kathīr hears heaven answering: It will be said — No, truly this is supreme success. Answered questions close dialogues. Closed dialogues certify wondering believers. Certified wonders rest in divine confirmation. Confirmed triumphs need no second witness. Others hear the believers concluding their own exclamation. Concluded exclamations need no heavenly voice. Voiceless seals still satisfy context. Context weighed, the passive It will be said favors heaven. Favored heaven speaks; believers listen and rejoice. Witness singular suffices where Speaker is divine. Divine speech seals human wondering. Wondering sealed, the dialogue completes. Completed dialogues display mercy's manners: mortals ask, Majesty answers. Answered mortals marvel at condescension. Condescending Majesty dignifies questioners. Dignified questioners shine among witnesses. Witnessed seals preach to later generations. Later generations hear and hasten. Hastening generations work for triumph. Working generations attain seals. Sealed generations praise forever.

**Triumph Named, Its Call Next**

Final verdicts brook no appeal. Appeals unneeded where grace abounds. Abounding grace confirms trembling hearts. Trembling hearts steadied praise loudly. Loud praise suits supreme success. Supreme successes end all seeking. Ended seeking rests in finding. Found triumphs satisfy eternally. Eternal satisfactions mock dunyā's morsels. Morsels of earth starve ambitious souls. Ambitious souls find fuller fare. Fuller fare feasts faithful winners. Faithful winners praise forever. Named triumphs close episodes. Closed episodes seal joys. Sealed joys satisfy fully. Fully satisfied, the passage pauses. Paused passages pivot outward. Outward pivots address the living. Addressed living hear verdicts applied. Triumph named, its call follows, as the coming verse will show.
verses.61:
> For such ˹honour˺ all should strive

**Like This Points Backward**

Li-mithli hādhā — for the like of this — gathers the preceding twenty verses into two words. “This” means everything since the passage turned Paradisal: provision, fruits, thrones, wine, companions, rescue, deathlessness. Demonstratives do theology here: salvation can be pointed at, not merely described. What was triumphantly named just before — “the ultimate triumph” (37:60) — now becomes a goal to pursue. Naming precedes commanding throughout the Book: show the prize, then summon the race. Prizes displayed motivate more powerfully than duties bare of promise. The verse therefore pivots the whole episode from description to exhortation. Pivots like this one turn narrative into sermon without breaking stride. Unbroken strides carry hearers from Garden visions to earthly resolve. Resolve formed in dunyā harvests in eternity.

**Honour Is Supplied, and Splendidly**

The Arabic says only “for the like of this” — no noun names the prize. “Honour” in brackets interprets the demonstrative: this dignity, this rank, this welcome. Supplied nouns risk narrowing; this one widens, gathering every bliss under esteem. Esteem captures what the passage emphasized: honored guests, thrones facing, beauty attending. Guests of the Merciful hold rank no earthly court confers. Courts confer titles; Paradise confers substance behind titles. Substantive honor outlasts ceremonial honor as eternity outlasts afternoons. The gloss therefore edifies even where Arabic stays silent. Silent demonstratives invite translators to speak; wise ones speak briefly. Brief brackets, broad honor: the gloss succeeds. Successful glosses disappear into understanding. Understanding achieved, brackets dissolve from memory. Dissolved scaffolding leaves the building standing. Standing buildings need no commentary.

**Workers Are Commanded to Work**

Fal-yaʿmali al-ʿāmilūn — let the workers work, let laborers labor. The imperative repeats its own root: working workers, laboring laborers. Root-repetition intensifies: work worthy of the name working. Unworthy work — drowsy, distracted, discontinuous — fails the verse's standard. Standards set high honor the prize: great aims demand great effort. Tanwīr al-Miqbās hears hastening: let those who hasten to righteous deeds hasten. Hastening workers outrun procrastination, the thief of triumphs. Tanwīr adds competing in spending: let spenders compete in Allah's way. Competing spenders turn wealth into ladder rungs. Ladders of charity climb toward honored thrones. Honored thrones await deliberate climbers. Deliberate climbers plan their ascent daily. Daily ascents accumulate into arrival. Arrival rewards every rung faithfully mounted.

**Whose Words: Allah or the Blessed**

Ibn Jarīr assigns the imperative to Allah: these are divine words summoning earthly workers. Divine summons suit the outward turn: heaven's tale now addresses dunyā's toilers. Tanwīr agrees in effect: Allah speaks to the blessed about workers below. Others hear the believers themselves exclaiming it, joy overflowing into exhortation. Jalālayn records both hearings neutrally: said to them, or said by them. Said by them, the verse crowns joy-speech with missionary zeal. Said to them, the verse pivots from story to sermon. Both hearings edify; the imperative reaches workers either way. Either way the grammar stays jussive and the goal stays Paradisal. Disputed speakers, undisputed summons: work for this. Undisputed summons tolerate disputed sources. Tolerated disputes enrich without dividing.

**In This World, for the Next**

Ibn Jarīr glosses the verse's logic: work here to attain there. Here and there divide by death but connect by deeds. Connected worlds make dunyā a farm and ākhirah its harvest. Farms demand sowing seasons; procrastinated sowings yield famines. Famines of merit starve souls eternally. Eternally starved, the heedless envy workers. Workers envied too late preach to workers in time. Timely workers sow while markets of mercy stay open. Open markets close at death's dusk. Dusks of life admit no further trading. Trading closed, accounts settle finally. Final settlements please prepared souls. Prepared souls enter honored ranks. Honored ranks welcome timely workers. Timely workers rest from righteous toil. Rested workers enjoy endless recompense. Endless recompense crowns finite striving.

**Reward Follows Work as Harvest Follows Sowing**

The sūrah stated the principle early: workers are “rewarded for what you used to do” (37:39). Principles precede exhibits: the rule announced, the tale illustrated, the command now seals. Sealed commands bind every conscience. Bound consciences work; unbound ones wish. Wishing never harvested; working always does. Harvest metaphors suit worker audiences: effort now, enjoyment later. Later enjoyment exceeds present effort as oceans exceed cups. Cups of toil poured out return as oceans of bliss. Returned oceans drown all regrets about effort spent. Spent efforts resurrected as pleasures preach perseverance. Perseverance preached produces patience. Produced patience endures dunyā's droughts. Droughts endured deepen workers' roots. Deepened roots anchor towering palms. Towering palms shade Paradisal workers. Shaded workers rest eternally.

**Striving Sounds Strenuous Because It Is**

“Should strive” renders ʿamal with exertion's overtone. Exertion belongs to the verse: Paradisal honor costs comfort. Comfort sacrificed becomes comfort multiplied. Multiplied comforts mock present ease. Present ease unmocked would seduce workers into idleness. Seduced idleness forfeits triumphs. Forfeited triumphs haunt Hell's regretful. Regretful hindsight preaches present foresight. Foresight heeded works while lamps burn. Burning lamps light limited hours. Limited hours demand urgent labor. Urgent labor redeems wasted years. Wasted years repented become lessons. Lessons learned sharpen remaining efforts. Sharpened efforts cut through distractions. Distractions severed, focus prevails. Prevailing focus finishes strong. Strong finishes crown weak starts. Weak starts forgiven, strong ends rewarded. Rewarded ends justify strenuous means. Strenuous means adorn willing workers.

**Command Given, Contrast Next**

Commands conclude episodes with outward force. Outward force redirects gazes from Garden to choice. Redirected gazes compare alternatives. Compared alternatives clarify decisions. Clear decisions follow stark contrasts. Stark contrasts await in the coming lines. Awaited contrasts sharpen striving's motives. Sharpened motives work harder and hope higher. Higher hopes sustain longer labors. Longer labors accumulate greater merit. Greater merits earn higher ranks. Higher ranks reflect harder striving. Harder striving proves sincere love. Sincere love works without weariness. Weariless work adorns noble souls. Noble souls deserve Paradisal honor. Deserved honors await appointed times. Appointed times arrive with death. Deaths of workers open Garden gates. Opened gates welcome striving souls. Command given, contrast comes next, as the coming verse will show.
verses.62:
> Is this ˹bliss˺ a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqûm

**A Question That Rebukes**

A-dhālika khayrun — is that better — asks what needs no asking. Unneeded questions accuse: the answer shames whoever chose worse. Zamakhsharī names the device: rebuke for the course the disbelievers chose. Chosen courses condemn choosers when alternatives stand displayed. Displayed alternatives leave no excuse of ignorance. Inexcusable choices deserve interrogation. Interrogations of the Book probe consciences, not information. Probed consciences squirm or submit. Submitted consciences choose bliss; squirming ones spitefully persist. Persisting spite hears rebuke as mockery. Mockery perceived hardens already-hard hearts. Hardened hearts shatter against questions. Shattered objections scatter like dust. Scattered dust settles nowhere. Nowhere settled, deniers drift. Drifting deniers miss both prizes. Missed prizes mock wasted lives.

**This Bliss Glosses That Delight**

Dhālika — that — points distantly at Paradise described. Distant pointing suits transcendent subjects: bliss beyond, bliss above. Our translator renders “this bliss,” closing the distance with brackets. Closed distances invite immediate comparison. Immediate comparisons press choices urgently. Urgent choices favor the vividly present. Present bliss outshines absent horror until horror arrives. Arrived horrors reverse the vividness. Reversed vividness comes too late for choosing. Late lessons lament in Hell. Lamenting lessons echo unavailingly. Unavailing echoes warn the living. Living warned choose while choosing lasts. Lasting choices shape eternal fates. Eternal fates hinge on present faith. Present faith selects Paradisal bliss. Bliss selected rewards comparing minds. Comparing minds weigh honestly. Honest weights tip toward Gardens. Gardens tipped toward welcome workers.

**Accommodation or Entertainment**

Nuzul means what a host prepares for guests: lodging, welcome meal, reception. Prepared receptions honor arrivals; Paradise prepares eternally. Eternally prepared, bliss never exhausts its welcome. Exhaustless welcomes contrast Hell's grudged provisions. Our translator chooses “accommodation,” stressing lodging. Ibn Kathīr prefers entertainment, stressing delight. Older renderings say welcome, stressing reception. Lodging, delight, reception: three facets of one hospitality. Single hospitalities unite all three. United meanings satisfy every translator partially. Partial satisfactions invite complementary readings. Complementary readings combine into fullness. Full hospitality lodges, delights, and receives. Received guests rest in honored places. Honored places suit honored workers. Honored workers deserve finest nuzul. Finest nuzul crowns divine generosity. Generous preparations shame meager hopes. Meager hopes exceeded praise lavish giving.

**Zaqqûm Enters by Name**

Shajaratu al-zaqqūm — the tree of Zaqqûm — names Hell's provision. Named horrors terrify more than vague ones. Vague threats blur; proper nouns point. Pointed nouns fix imagination on facts. Fixed facts resist dismissive shrugs. Dismissals attempted recoil upon deniers. Recoiling denials confirm prophetic warnings. Confirmed warnings accumulate across the sūrah. Accumulated warnings leave deniers inexcusable. Inexcusable deniers face named provisions. Named provisions contrast deliberately. Deliberate contrasts teach choosing. Choosing taught, excuses vanish. Vanished excuses expose bare wills. Bare wills choose bliss or blaze. Blazes chosen consume choosers. Consumed choosers lament eternally. Eternal laments warn timely hearers. Timely hearers choose the Garden. Garden chosen, Zaqqûm shunned.

**Fruits Against Zaqqûm**

The contrast answers verses 41–42 deliberately: known provision against notorious poison. Provision promised delights; provision threatened horrifies. Horrified hearers should reconsider allegiances. Reconsidered allegiances may yet save. Saving reconsiderations please the Merciful. Pleased mercy accepts late repentance. Late repentance beats Hell's provisions. Provisions of Hell nourish only torment. Torment nourished grows by eating. Eating increases agony wondrously. Wondrous agonies defy earthly analogies. Earthly analogies fail before Zaqqûm. Zaqqûm's horrors exceed imagining. Imagining exceeded surrenders to texts. Texts trusted guide the wise. Wise guided choose fruits over fire. Fires of Hell consume mockers. Consumed mockers warn survivors. Surviving hearers act urgently. Urgent actions seize remaining chances. Remaining chances narrow daily. Narrowing chances urge immediate turning. Immediate turning finds open doors. Open doors welcome prodigal workers.

**Better Asks for Verdicts**

Khayrun — better — demands comparison's conclusion. Concluded comparisons convict choosers of worse. Worse choosers stand self-condemned. Self-condemned, excuses evaporate. Evaporated excuses leave wills exposed. Exposed wills chose Zaqqûm knowingly. Knowing choices bear full guilt. Guilty choosers face fitting fare. Fitting fare matches foul choices. Foul choices deserve bitter fruits. Bitter fruits await in Hell. Hell's orchards grow one crop. One crop suffices all damned. Damned diners dread each course. Dreaded courses arrive inevitably. Inevitable arrivals crush false hopes. False hopes starve in Hell. Starved hopes feed on nothing. Nothing feeds Hell's residents but fire. Fire-fed residents envy Gardens. Envied Gardens admit workers only. Only workers taste fruits. Fruits tasted reward striving. Rewarded striving vindicates faith. Vindicated faith praises choosing rightly. Rightly choosing belongs to the wise.

**Taste the Torment, Literally**

Hell's fare fulfills the sūrah's threat: diners “taste the painful torment” (37:38). Tasting turns abstract warning into palate fact. Palate facts persuade where propositions merely allege. Alleged torments doubted become experienced torments certain. Certain torments tasted eternally define damnation. Defined damnation warns decisively. Decisive warnings demand decisions. Demanded decisions divide humanity. Divided humanity sorts into diners. Diners sorted eat fruits or fire. Fires eaten burn from within. Within-burning exceeds without-burning. Without-burning scorches skin; within-burning melts cores. Melted cores scream silently. Silent screams fill Hell. Hell filled with tasted torment. Tasted torment teaches too late. Late teachings lament eternally. Eternal laments echo warnings. Echoed warnings reach mortal ears. Mortal ears hear and tremble. Trembling hearers choose wisely.

**Question Posed, Trial Next**

Rebuking questions open; explaining verses follow. Following verses disclose Zaqqûm further. Further disclosures deepen dread. Deepened dread serves mercy: frightened sinners repent. Repentant sinners escape Zaqqûm's shade. Escaped diners praise warning questions. Praised warnings vindicate revelation. Vindicated revelation guides generations. Guided generations avoid Zaqqûm. Avoided Zaqqûm proves questions effective. Effective questions rebuke and rescue. Rescued rebels praise interrogating mercy. Interrogating mercy wounds to heal. Healing wounds scar into wisdom. Scarred wisdom warns others. Others warned may yet escape. Escapes effected glorify guidance. Glorified guidance deserves gratitude. Grateful guided obey promptly. Prompt obedience pleases the Warner. Pleased Warners lighten sentences. Lightened sentences spare repentant rebels. Repentant rebels rejoin workers. Rejoined workers strive for Gardens. Question posed, its sequel follows, as the coming verse will show.
verses.63:
> We have surely made it a test for the wrongdoers

**We Made It: Divine Agency in Testing**

Innā jaʿalnāhā — We have made it — claims divine authorship of the trial. Authored trials test deliberately: heaven designs examinations. Designed examinations distinguish believers from mockers. Distinguished outcomes sort humanity eternally. Eternally sorted, souls inhabit chosen fates. Chosen fates reflect answered tests. Answered tests reveal hidden hearts. Hidden hearts harbor faith or scorn. Harbored scorn surfaces under trial. Surfaced scorn condemns its carriers. Carriers of contempt face fitting trials. Fitting trials expose secret mockery. Secret mockery voiced becomes public sin. Public sins invite public refutation. Public refutations silence arrogant objectors. Arrogant objectors stumble over marvels. Stumbling still, mockers trip and fall. Fallen mockers illustrate fitnah. Illustrated fitnah warns later skeptics. Later skeptics repeat old sneers. Old sneers meet eternal answers.

**The Tree Named Last Verse**

“It” refers backward: “the tree of Zaqqûm” (37:62). Backward reference chains verses tightly. Tightly chained, the passage progresses. Progressing passages build arguments. Built arguments corner deniers. Cornered deniers lash or listen. Listening cornered ones escape. Escaped listeners praise chaining verses. Chained verses display coherent warnings. Coherent warnings persuade rational minds. Rational minds follow references. Followed references reveal purposes. Revealed purposes vindicate mentionings. Mentioned trees test hearers. Tested hearers divide by response. Responses divided separate fates. Separated fates finalize eternally. Eternal finalizations sober the wise. Sobered wise believe promptly. Prompt belief passes trials. Passed trials earn Gardens. Gardens earned reward tested faith. Tested faith receives fitting rewards. Fitting rewards crown patient believers. Patient believers praise trials.

**Test or Torment: Fitnah's Range**

Fitnah spans trial, temptation, torment: testing that burns. Burning tests purify believers and consume mockers. Consumed mockers illustrate fitnah's edge. Edged trials cut both ways. Both ways wound; one way heals. Healed believers thank trials. Thanked trials bless the grateful. Grateful blessed endure more. More endured earns higher ranks. Higher ranks reward tested faith. Tested faith proves genuine. Genuine faith survives Zaqqûm's mention. Mentioned Zaqqûm divides audiences. Divided audiences sort eternally. Eternal sorting vindicates trials. Vindicated trials glorify divine wisdom. Divine wisdom tests appropriately. Appropriate tests fit each soul. Fitted souls face tailored trials. Tailored trials justly judge. Just judgments silence complaints. Silenced complaints concede justice. Conceded justice stills all protest. Stilled protests honor truth. Honored truth reigns supreme.

**Most Say Trial, Some Say Punishment**

Most commentators translate fitnah here as trial or test. Tests of belief suit the context: a tree in Fire strains credulity. Strained credulity snaps into mockery or stretches into faith. Stretching faith pleases the Tester. Pleased Testers reward trusting souls. Trusting souls pass unseen examinations. Unseen examinations grade eternal transcripts. Graded transcripts determine placements. Placed souls inhabit deserved abodes. Deserved abodes match tested hearts. Tested hearts prove sincere. Sincere hearts believe trees in Fire. Fire-trees believed display omnipotence trusted. Trusted omnipotence saves believers. Others hear punishment: the tree torments eaters. Tormenting trees punish wrongdoers. Wrongdoers eating suffer fitnah. Suffered fitnah fits criminals. Fitting criminals, torment satisfies justice. Satisfied justice closes cases. Trial here, torment there: both true across two worlds. Worlds divided, fitnah spans both.

**Fire Consumes Trees — So How**

Qatādah preserves the objection: fire consumes trees, so how can one grow there? Reasonable objections deserve answers, not dismissal. Undismissed objections receive revelation's reply. Revelation replies: the Gardener commands flames. Commanded flames nourish instead of consuming. Nourishing flames invert nature at will. Willed inversions display absolute power. Absolute power answers “how” with “thus.” Thus-answers humble questioning minds. Humbled minds accept revealed paradoxes. Paradoxes accepted stretch comprehension. Stretched comprehension worships omnipotence. Worshipped omnipotence explains all marvels. Marvelous explanations satisfy submitters. Satisfied submitters cease objecting. Ceased objections rest in trust. Trusted revelations guide safely. Safe guidance leads through paradox. Paradox traversed strengthens faith. Strengthened faith welcomes revealed wonders. Welcomed wonders adorn belief.

**Dates and Butter: Abu Jahl's Feast**

Abū Jahl mocked the menace with menus: bring dates and butter. In Berber speech zaqqūm meant butter-topped dates, a delicacy. Delicacies invoked defuse dread — or attempt to. Attempted defusions display desperate denial. Desperate denials amuse accomplices briefly. Brief amusements purchase eternal horrors. Purchased horrors arrive on schedule. Scheduled horrors mock the mockers. Mocked mockers wail in Zaqqûm's shade. Shaded wailers eat promised fruit. Promised delicacies arrive as torments. Tormenting banquets feed scornful eaters. Scornful eaters choke on contempt. Choking contempt seals mocking mouths. Sealed mouths moan eternally. Eternal moans answer ancient mockery. Ancient mockery warns modern tongues. Modern tongues repeat old sneers. Old sneers earn fresh torments. Fresh torments await unrepentant mockers. Unrepentant mockers join Abū Jahl.

**The Accursed Tree of 17:60**

Another passage names it “the accursed tree” (17:60), also made a trial. Twin trials frame one purpose: sifting believers from scoffers. Sifted believers shine; sifted scoffers burn. Burning sifted ones validate warnings. Validated warnings accumulate authority. Accumulated authority commands assent. Commanded assent tests wills. Tested wills choose faith or fire. Faith chosen escapes accursed branches. Branches accursed shade only damned. Damned shaded suffer doubly. Doubly suffering fits double guilt. Guilt doubled: disbelief plus mockery. Mockery added aggravates sentences. Aggravated sentences crush scoffers. Crushed scoffers confess too late. Late confessions echo unheard. Unheard confessions haunt Hell. Haunting confessions warn earth. Earth warned chooses faith. Faith chosen blooms in Gardens. Blooming Gardens contrast accursed branches. Branches contrasted clarify choices. Clarified choices save souls.

**Test Decreed, Tree Described Next**

Decreed tests precede described trees. Described trees follow in sequel. Following sequels detail further. Further details deepen understanding. Deepened understanding strengthens faith. Strengthened faith passes tests. Passed tests earn Paradisal shade. Shaded passers pity Zaqqûm's diners. Diners pitied prompt urgent warnings. Urgent warnings seek listening ears. Listening ears hear and heed. Heeded hearings save souls. Saved souls praise testing wisdom. Testing wisdom orders trials justly. Justly ordered trials convince all. Convinced all confess divine justice. Divine justice tests and rewards. Rewarded tested ones rejoice. Rejoicing tested ones enter Gardens. Gardens entered shelter from Zaqqûm. Sheltered believers forget trials. Forgotten trials fade into praise. Faded trials leave pure gratitude. Pure gratitude sings eternally. Test decreed, its tree comes next, as the coming verse will show.
verses.64:
> Indeed, it is a tree that grows in the depths of Hell

**Indeed Opens Emphatically**

Innahā — indeed it, truly it — swears certainty about paradox. Paradoxical trees need emphatic particles. Emphatic particles steady staggering minds. Staggering minds confront fire-fed foliage. Fire-fed foliage defies botany. Defied botany bows to omnipotence. Bowed sciences worship their Maker. Maker worshipped orders nature freely. Freely ordered nature obeys instantly. Instant obedience produces fire-trees. Fire-trees produced puzzle philosophers. Puzzled philosophers speculate vainly. Vain speculations miss revelation. Missed revelations blind the proud. Blinded proud stumble over marvels. Stumbling marvels trip mockers. Tripped mockers fall into Fire. Fallen mockers eat paradox. Eaten paradoxes torment deniers. Tormented deniers confess omnipotence. Confessed omnipotence vindicates particles. Vindicated indeeds introduce wonders. Wonders introduced demand belief. Demanded beliefs receive divine aid. Aided believers grasp paradoxes. Grasped paradoxes become principles. Principles grasped guide lives.

**A Tree Grows — Audaciously**

Shajarah — a tree — claims normal botany for abnormal soil. Claimed normalcy startles: trees need earth, water, light. Needed things replaced by flames. Replaced natures obey new orders. New orders issue from absolute will. Absolute wills plant paradoxical orchards. Paradoxical orchards shade the damned. Shaded damned find no relief. Reliefless shade mocks shelter-seekers. Shelter-seekers find scorching branches. Scorching branches blister reaching hands. Blistered hands drop bitter fruit. Bitter fruits recall wasted warnings. Wasted warnings haunt hungry eaters. Hungry eaters devour horrors. Devoured horrors boil within. Boiling innards scream silently. Silent screams unheard lament. Unheard laments fill Hell's orchards. Orchards of torment grow eternally. Eternal growth feeds endless hunger. Endless hunger never satisfied. Unsatisfied hunger gnaws eternally. Eternal gnawing maddens diners. Maddened diners curse orchards.

**The Test Named Last Verse**

“It” continues the referent: “a test for the wrongdoers” (37:63). Continued referents bind descriptions to decrees. Bound descriptions explain tested things. Explained things lose mystery but gain dread. Gained dread serves mercy's warnings. Mercy's warnings precede just sentences. Just sentences follow rejected warnings. Rejected warnings aggravate guilt. Aggravated guilt deserves grown trees. Grown trees await appointed eaters. Appointed eaters approach reluctantly. Reluctant approaches delay nothing. Delayed nothing, sentences proceed. Proceeding sentences seat diners. Seated diners face branches. Branches lowered offer fruit. Offered fruits accepted unwillingly. Unwilling acceptances choke throats. Choked throats swallow torment. Swallowed torments boil bellies. Boiled bellies bloat in agony. Agonized bloats burst inwardly. Burst torments recycle eternally.

**Roots in the Bottom**

Fī aṣli al-jaḥīm — in the root, the bottom, the depths of the Blaze. Bottoms of Hell anchor horrors. Anchored horrors stand immovable. Immovable horrors await occupants. Awaiting occupants descend progressively. Progressive descents deepen doom. Deepened dooms center sufferers. Centered sufferers recall the companion “in the midst of the Hellfire” (37:55). Recalled centers concentrate dread. Concentrated dread pools at bottoms. Bottom-pooled dread drowns souls. Drowned souls sink further. Further sinking finds roots. Rooted horrors grip ankles. Gripped ankles cannot flee. Fleeless souls feed trees. Trees fed by damned grow taller. Taller trees shade lower depths. Lower depths house worst offenders. Worst offenders deserve deepest roots. Deepest roots anchor ultimate torments.

**Nourished by Fire**

Ibn Kathīr reports the marvel: nourished by fire, created from fire. Fire-created flora inverts creation's pattern. Inverted patterns proclaim unrestrained power. Unrestrained power plants impossibilities. Planted impossibilities fruit horrors. Fruited horrors feed wrongdoers. Fed wrongdoers fuel flames further. Further fuels intensify Hell. Intensified Hell burns hotter. Hotter burning feeds trees better. Better-fed trees fruit thicker. Thicker fruits torment more. More torment fits greater guilt. Greater guilt deserves hotter Hell. Hotter Hells cycle endlessly. Endless cycles crush hope. Hopeless cycles grind souls. Ground souls powder into ash. Ashen souls reconstituted suffer anew. Renewed suffering repeats cycles. Repeated cycles never conclude. Unconcluded torments warn mortals. Mortal warned choose Gardens. Gardens chosen shelter from fire-trees. Fire-trees shunned prove warnings effective. Effective warnings save multitudes.

**Branches Through the Levels**

Others extend the image: roots below, branches through every level — compatible, not contrary. Described extents magnify the menace. Magnified menaces deter rational souls. Deterred souls choose Gardens. Garden-choosers escape branches. Escaped branches wave emptily. Empty wavings mock absent diners. Absent diners feast on fruits. Fruited feasts contrast fiery branches. Branches contrasted clarify options. Clarified options demand decisions. Demanded decisions divide diners. Divided diners occupy opposite orchards. Opposite orchards fruit eternally. Eternal fruiting feeds respective residents. Respective residents eat fittingly. Fitting foods match earned fates. Earned fates finalize justly. Just finalizations please the just. Pleased justice rests in wisdom. Wise arrangements silence objections. Silenced objections concede fittingness. Fittingness perceived praises order. Extended or anchored, one tree torments all levels.

**Paradox Affirmed, Objection Answered**

“Fire consumes trees” meets its answer: this one it feeds. Fed flames foster foliage. Fostered foliage fruits torment. Fruited torment feeds objectors. Fed objectors choke on answers. Choked answers silence objections. Silenced objections concede omnipotence. Conceded omnipotence worships. Worshipping objectors convert to believers. Converted believers praise paradox. Praised paradoxes adorn omnipotence. Adorned omnipotence attracts hearts. Attracted hearts trust revelations. Trusted revelations explain marvels. Explained marvels strengthen convictions. Strengthened convictions endure trials. Endured trials earn Gardens. Gardens earned shelter converts. Sheltered converts forget objections. Forgotten objections dissolve in bliss. Blissful converts praise testing grace. Testing grace sifted them kindly. Kindly sifted, they shine. Shining converts guide others.

**Tree Placed, Fruit Next**

Placed trees await further portrayal. Further portrayals follow in sequel. Following sequels complete pictures. Completed pictures preach fully. Fully preached, warnings work. Working warnings save hearers. Saved hearers praise detailed revelation. Detailed revelations describe exactly. Exactly described horrors deter effectively. Effective deterrents redirect travelers. Redirected travelers choose Gardens. Gardens chosen reward warnings. Rewarded warnings vindicate texts. Vindicated texts guide nations. Guided nations prosper eternally. Eternal prosperity contrasts Zaqqûm. Contrasted Zaqqûm repels wisely. Wise repelled ones praise portrayals. Praised portrayals teach vividly. Vivid teachings stick in memory. Memories stuck shape choices. Shaped choices determine destinies. Tree placed, its sequel follows, as the coming verse will show.
verses.65:
> bearing fruit like devils’ heads

**Fruit Borne for Torment**

Ṭalʿuhā — its spathe, its fruit-stalks, its fruit — dangles horror visibly. Visible horrors repel before touching. Repelled gazers recoil appropriately. Appropriate recoil honors warnings. Honored warnings work mercifully. Merciful workings spare believers. Spared believers praise similes. Praised similes teach effectively. Effective teachings employ images. Employed images impress memories. Impressed memories retain warnings. Retained warnings guide choices. Guided choices avoid orchards. Avoided orchards prove similes successful. Successful similes glorify revelation. Glorified revelation guides nations. Guided nations shun Zaqqûm. Shunned horrors testify eternally. Eternal testimonies warn mortals. Warned mortals choose Gardens. Gardens chosen exclude Zaqqûm. Excluded horrors fade from sight. Sight-faded horrors trouble none. Troubled none, bliss reigns. Reigning bliss excludes fear. Feared nothing, residents rejoice.

**Growing Where It Grows**

The tree stands planted where described: it “grows in the depths of Hell” (37:64). Described depths contextualize dreadful fruit. Dreadful fruits suit dreadful roots. Rooted dread fruits horror. Horrored fruits await the doomed. Doomed gazers behold decrees. Beheld decrees fulfill justice. Fulfilled decrees display justice. Displayed justice convinces witnesses. Convinced witnesses praise sentences. Praised sentences deter mortals. Deterred mortals avoid orchards. Avoided orchards prove warnings heard. Heard warnings save listeners. Saved listeners praise depth-descriptions. Depth-descriptions detail damnation. Detailed damnation terrifies appropriately. Appropriate terror produces piety. Produced piety pleases the Warner. Pleased Warners lighten burdens. Lightened burdens ease striving. Eased striving succeeds.

**Like Devils' Heads**

Ka-annahu ruʾūsu al-shayāṭīn — like the heads of devils. Devils' heads crown horror's portrait. Portrayed horrors exceed witnessed ones. Exceeded sights stagger imagination. Staggered imaginations surrender to texts. Surrendered imaginations picture obediently. Obedient picturing terrifies appropriately. Appropriate terror deters wisely. Wise deterrence saves souls. Saved souls avoid devil-fruits. Avoided fruits hang untasted. Untasted horrors threaten the damned alone. Alone threatened, the damned despair. Despairing damned face fitting fare. Fitting fare matches foul deeds. Foul deeds deserve devil-fruits. Devil-fruits dangle dreadfully. Dreadful dangling deters mortals. Mortals deterred choose Gardens. Chosen Gardens contrast Hell's orchards. Contrasted orchards clarify fates. Clarified fates finalize eternally. Eternal finality sobers seekers. Sobered seekers embrace faith. Embraced faith produces works. Produced works earn Gardens. Gardens earned exclude devil-fruits.

**Devils or Serpents**

Most hear devils proper: shayāṭīn in its recognized sense. Sensed devils horrify by reputation. Reputed horrors need no sightings. Unsighted horrors work imaginatively. Imaginative workings suffice for warnings. Sufficing warnings deter effectively. Effective deterrents employ familiar fears. Familiar fears feature devils. Featuring devils, the verse follows convention. Conventional images persuade commonly. Common persuasions employ shared stock. Shared stocks include serpent-hoods too. Some hear serpents: zaqqūm-spathes resemble snakes' hoods. Resembling hoods, the simile turns visible. Visible similes convince observers. Convinced observers shudder appropriately. Appropriate shudders deter effectively. Effectively deterred, souls escape. Escaped souls praise vivid similes. Vivid similes suit visible fruits. Visible fruits deserve visible likenesses. Likenesses visible convince doubters. Doubters convinced abandon denial. Denial abandoned saves souls. Saved souls vindicate either likeness. Either likeness terrifies sufficiently. Sufficient terror fulfills the verse. The literal sense stands: devils, unseen but proverbial. Proverbial devils need no specimens. Specimens unseen terrify nonetheless. Nonetheless terrifying, the simile succeeds.

**Similes Need No Sightings**

Maʿārif al-Qurʾān dissolves the puzzle: nobody has seen devils, yet all picture them. Pictured devils populate proverbs. Proverbial devils embody ugliness. Embodied ugliness needs no specimens. Specimen-free similes still terrify. Terrifying similes employ shared imagination. Shared imaginations picture ghosts and ghouls. Ghosts pictured frighten children and ancients. Ancient fears persist in phrases. Phrases persisting shape perceptions. Shaped perceptions interpret fruits. Interpreted fruits horrify hearers. Horrified hearers believe warnings. Believed warnings save believers. Saved believers praise imaginative mercy. Imaginative mercy employs familiar fears. Familiar fears feature jinn and ghosts. Ghosts featured frighten fittingly. Fitting frights fulfill revelation. Fulfilled revelations guide generations. Generations guided shun devil-fruits. Devil-fruits shunned hang lonely. Lonely horrors await the damned.

**Ugliness Beyond Measure**

Ibn Kathīr states the simile's function: describing utter repulsiveness. Repulsive fruits repel gazers. Repelled gazers recoil. Recoiling gazers warn others. Warned others avoid orchards. Avoided orchards stand lonely. Lonely orchards testify. Testifying orchards preach. Preaching orchards warn mortals. Warned mortals choose beauty. Beauty chosen blooms in Gardens. Gardens blooming contrast Zaqqûm. Contrasted Zaqqûm clarifies fates. Clarified fates divide humanity. Divided humanity sorts eternally. Eternal sorting finalizes abodes. Finalized abodes house fitting residents. Fitting residents match earned ends. Earned ends reflect chosen paths. Chosen paths diverged in dunyā. Dunyā divergences decide eternities. Decided eternities admit no appeal. Appealless fates sober seekers. Sobered seekers choose Gardens. Gardens chosen exclude horrors. Excluded horrors fade forever.

**Shared Punishment, Fitting Fruit**

The damned together “share in the punishment” (37:33), and share its fruit's horror. Shared horrors horrify collectively. Collective horrors isolate nonetheless. Isolated sufferers crowd Hell. Crowded sufferers wail unheard. Unheard wails fill depths. Filled depths resound forever. Forever resounding, torments continue. Continued torments crush hope. Crushed hopes despair eternally. Eternal despair defines damnation. Defined damnation warns decisively. Decisive warnings demand decisions. Demanded decisions divide humanity. Divided humanity sorts by faith. Sorted faiths determine fruits. Determined fruits mark abodes. Marked abodes display justice. Displayed justice convinces witnesses. Witnessed justice glorifies order. Glorified order reigns supreme. Supreme rule never errs. Erring never, justice stands. Standing justice anchors faith. Anchored faiths endure trials.

**Fruit Crowned, Sequel Next**

Crowned fruits complete portraits. Completed portraits preach powerfully. Powerful preaching persuades. Persuaded souls escape. Escaped souls praise portrayals. Praised portrayals teach eternally. Eternal teachings guide pilgrims. Guided pilgrims reach Gardens. Reached Gardens exclude Zaqqûm. Excluded Zaqqûm fades from memory. Faded memories yield to present bliss. Present bliss absorbs attention. Absorbed attention forgets horrors. Forgotten horrors lose sting. Stingless pasts comfort residents. Comforted residents praise mercy. Praised mercy multiplies joys. Multiplied joys fill eternity. Eternity filled satisfies fully. Fully satisfied, bliss completes. Completed bliss crowns believers. Crowned believers rest forever. Forever rested, they praise. Praised endlessly, grace abounds. Abounding grace exceeds all telling. Told triumphs inspire strivers. Inspired strivers work righteously. Righteous work earns Gardens. Fruit crowned, its sequel follows, as the coming verse will show.
verses.66:
> The evildoers will certainly ˹be left to˺ eat from it, filling up their bellies with it

**Evildoers Named as Diners**

Fa-innahum — so indeed they — resumes the wrongdoers with emphasis. Resumed subjects refocus attention: evildoers, not trees, stand central. Central sinners face fitting fare. Fitting fares match foul deeds. Foul deeds deserve devil-fruits. Devil-fruits await appointed eaters. Doomed diners approach in dread. Dreading approaches delay nothing. Delayed nothing, the meal proceeds. Proceeding meals sicken participants. Sickened participants retch helplessly. Helpless retching brings no relief. Reliefless meals continue eternally. Eternal meals mock nourishment. Mocked nourishment starves souls. Starved souls weaken endlessly. Endless weakening wearies the damned. Wearied damned curse appetites. Cursed appetites crave still. Still craving, they devour horrors. Devoured horrors boil within. Boiling bellies bloat painfully. Painful bloats burst inwardly.

**Certainly Eats: Emphasis on Ineluctability**

La-ākilūna — they will certainly eat — seals inevitability with lām. Sealed inevitabilities admit no escape. Escapeless eaters face branches. Faced branches lower fruit. Lowered fruits hang heavily. Heavy hangings horrify gazers. Horrified gazers become eaters. Eaters become sufferers. Suffering eaters lament loudly. Loud laments echo unheard. Unheard echoes fill Hell. Hell filled resounds forever. Resounding forever, torments persist. Continued torments crush hope. Crushed hopes despair eternally. Eternal despair defines damnation. Defined damnation warns decisively. Decisive warnings demand decisions. Demanded decisions divide humanity. Divided humanity sorts by faith. Sorted faiths determine fates. Determined fates finalize eternally. Eternal finalizations sober seekers. Sobered seekers embrace Gardens. Gardens embraced exclude Zaqqûm. Excluded Zaqqûm proves Gardens merciful. Merciful Gardens welcome workers.

**Be Left To: Abandonment as Punishment**

“Be left to” in brackets interprets passivity: abandoned to appetite. Abandoned appetites rule the damned. Ruling appetites tyrannize souls. Tyrannized souls obey bellies. Obedient bellies demand filling. Demanded fillings arrive as torment. Arriving torments satisfy nothing. Satisfied nothing, hunger persists. Persisting hunger gnaws eternally.
